how_to_use: Load fixture 'standard' as the user context unless a case overrides it.
Feed 'input.transcript' plus any ASR metadata. Compare the model's tool call to 'expected'.
'reply_example' shows the intent and style of a passing reply. Do NOT require an exact string match. Score the reply with 'pass_if' and 'fail_if' using an LLM grader plus automatic checks.

Global automatic checks on EVERY reply: no markdown or symbols, no repeated sentence or n-gram, no echo of the user's fillers or self-corrections, no filler opener ('Sure', 'Absolutely'), median length two sentences or fewer, no confirmation of an action before tool success.
decision values: ACT (execute now), CONFIRM (restate the risky detail and wait), ASK (one short question, options named), NONE (no tool call), SILENT (say nothing).
